headline: Southern (SO) Secures 25 Year OpenAI Power Deal In Georgia
summary: Southern Company (NYSE:SO) has entered a 25-year agreement to supply power to OpenAI's planned data center in Georgia. The long-term contract supports OpenAI's energy needs for a large-scale computing facility in the state. The project is expected to bring economic growth, new jobs, and infrastructure investment to the surrounding communities. headline: Southern (SO) Stock Looks About Right With Strong Returns But Pricey Earnings
summary: Southern stock has delivered an 83.1% total return over the past five years, yet its current valuation checks suggest the shares no longer stand out as a clear bargain. With the market treating the stock as roughly fairly priced on key multiples, investors now have to reconcile that picture with recent news around long term power deals and customer protection pledges. Over five years, Southern has returned 83.1%. This puts recent gains into context and raises the bar for any further upside...
